messages.content:
Task: Implement JSON notes storage module

Create notes.py with a small standard-library-only API for storing notes in a JSON file in the working directory, defaulting to notes.json. Expose add(note, path='notes.json'), list(path='notes.json'), and delete(index, path='notes.json'). Store notes as a JSON array of strings; treat a missing file as an empty list; make delete use 1-based numbering and raise IndexError for out-of-range indexes.

Acceptance criteria:
- notes.py imports only Python standard-library modules.
- add appends a note and persists it to the JSON file.
- list returns notes in insertion order and returns an empty list when the file is missing.
- delete removes the requested 1-based note number and persists the updated list.
- Out-of-range delete raises IndexError without corrupting the JSON file.

The workspace is yours. When the work is done, reply with a short summary of the files you created or changed.

You work alone in an empty workspace directory using the tools provided: write files with write_file, inspect with read_file and list_dir, run commands with shell, and run pytest with run_tests. Work incrementally: create the code, create the tests, run the tests, fix what fails, and only finish when the tests pass. Keep files small and dependency-free (standard library only). Do not ask questions; make reasonable choices and state them.

Available tools:
- read_file: Read a text file in the workspace (optionally a line range).
- write_file: Create or overwrite a text file in the workspace (parents are created).
- list_dir: List files and directories under a workspace path.
- shell: Run a shell command in the workspace; returns stdout, stderr, exit code.
- run_tests: Run pytest on a workspace path (default: the whole workspace).

Work on the task using the tools when they help. When the task is done, reply with the final answer in plain text and stop calling tools. Never claim a tool ran unless you called it and saw its result.
